ms.report:
POA M2: VIDEO v2
(https://drive.google.com/file/d/1wWNwmYUfPhuVxwrKr_4qM8MH02mXrvAp/view?usp=sharing) 

Thank you for your review and feedback.
We’d like to clarify that the milestone acceptance criteria specify one (1) single behind-the-scenes video containing two elements: 1) production footage and 2) a short interview with the presenters. The criteria do not require two separate videos.
That said, we’ve created a new version of the milestone video to better align with your requests:
 • Removed background music for easier following,
 • Added clear graphics to label and distinguish workshop content (named Workshop 1/2/3/4), behind-the-scenes footage, and interview segments,
 • Uploaded the file as a public video on google drive.
The previous version of the POA video will also remain uploaded. Please note that unlisted YouTube videos are public and can always be accessed through the official link, so both versions will remain publicly available for full transparency.
Finally, just to clarify: the full workshop recordings are not part of this milestone, but are scheduled for editing and publishing under Milestone 3. We look forward to sharing those soon.
Thanks again for your review.
